question: What documents are needed for a part-time work permit?
reference_answer: Prepare the application form, passport, residence card, transcript or certificate of attendance, language-proficiency proof, and the international-student part-time-employment confirmation signed by the responsible university officer. You also need the employer's business-registration copy and a standard employment contract; manufacturing or construction cases require the additional compliance confirmation and employer ID copy.

the employment confirmation needs the international-student officer's signature
the employer documents include business registration and a standard employment contract

question: Which insurance rules apply to me?
reference_answer: It depends on your campus. At ERICA you have the university group insurance (KRW 25,000, billed with tuition) and National Health Insurance, charged at 50% of an alien resident premium. At Seoul Hanyang pays a private insurance for enrolled students and you also pay National Health Insurance (79,320 won a month from March 2026).

question: Where do I check my result and what comes after that?
reference_answer: Check your result on the OIA admission results page for international students (undergraduate), then follow the acceptance guideline that matches the "Korean Language" result on your result page. If you pass or are exempt: print the tuition bill and pay between 18 June and 9 July 2026, submit missing documents by 16 July, then apply for the Certificate of Admission (by 16 July) and your visa. If you did not meet the Korean standard: submit additional language documents or apply to Hanyang IIE, and you will be placed on leave for the first semester.
